summary: Australian Oilseeds Holdings filed a Form 6-K reporting results of an extraordinary general meeting held November 10, 2026 (record date October 21, 2026), conducted virtually. Shareholders approved an 80-for-1 share consolidation across class A, class B and preference shares (par from US$0.0001 to US$0.008), a Cayman Islands share capital reduction and reorganization cutting par to US$0.000001, a subsequent authorised share capital increase to US$1,000 divided into 999,312,500 class A shares, and amended articles. These are routine capital-structure housekeeping measures, not a special situation; no price, premium or advisor terms. Watch Nasdaq effectiveness timing and post-consolidation liquidity.
